scope: MLB regular season only. 2019–2025 historical adapter/certification; 2026 separate 2027-history-only outputs.
hitter_cohort: For target Y, freeze exact MLBAM IDs with positive eligible MLB PA in any of Y-4..Y-1, matching baseline history policy. Includes secondary-role batting records; no roster/debut/prospect expansion.
appearance: Credited batting gamesPlayed=1, including zero-PA appearances; roster listing is not appearance. Pitching gamesPitched=1, including zero-out/no-pitch appearances.
starts: Batting initial order code 100..900 ending00, corroborated with isSubstitute where present. A starting batting-order assignment is distinct from credited G. Pitching gamesStarted splits actual outing outs; never season IP/GS.
lineup: Store each batting order code, slot, substitution index and starting flag; no inference from final team battingOrder alone.
late_window: Last60 completed regular-season team games in each source season, sorted officialDate/gameNumber/gamePk; trades remain in game/team records. No target-season features.
zero_policy: Only certify absent members of frozen prior-positive-PA cohort when full-season schedule/standings and every game validate and no eligible source positive label contradicts absence. Numeric mismatches quarantine affected player usage. Unknown is not zero.
identity: Canonical positive MLBAM from eligible prior-history labels; source role and each boxscore person.id exact. No name-only links and no current roster requirement for historical nonappearance.
source: Read-only existing cached official MLB JSON wrappers, bound to original certification hashes; no new download or current depth charts
